I'll start by finding the spike report, since the right edit depends on how it's written.


<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/*</parameter>
<parameter name="path"><scratchpad>/spike</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Grep">
<parameter name="pattern">p95|200ms|240ms|PASS|FAIL</parameter>
<parameter name="path"><scratchpad>/spike</parameter>
<parameter name="output_mode">content</parameter>
<parameter name="-n">true</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">pwd && ls -la <scratchpad>/spike</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/*spike*</parameter>
<parameter name="path">~/work/attractor-guided-evolution</parameter>
</invoke>

<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/*report*</parameter>
<parameter name="path">~/work/attractor-guided-evolution</parameter>
</invoke>








<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">pwd; ls -la</parameter>
</invoke>












<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/*</parameter>
<parameter name="path">~/work/attractor-guided-evolution</parameter>
</invoke>














<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">ls -la <scratchpad>/spike 2>&1 | head -50; echo ---; ls ~/work/attractor-guided-evolution 2>&1 | head -50</parameter>
</invoke>














<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">cd <scratchpad>/spike && pwd && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -50</parameter>
</invoke>














<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">find <tmp> ~/work/attractor-guided-evolution -maxdepth 6 \( -iname '*spike*' -o -iname '*report*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -50</parameter>
</invoke>




<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">pwd; ls -la; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '</parameter>
</invoke>
